title: Public Health Authorities Call for Stronger Community Engagement in DRC Ebola Response
detail: Public health authorities issued calls for stronger community engagement in the DRC Ebola response on June 11, 2026, signaling ongoing challenges in containing the outbreak in Congo-Kinshasa. Community engagement remains a critical bottleneck in the response, with contact tracing coverage still critically below the 90% threshold needed for effective containment. Low community trust and logistical barriers continue to hamper isolation efforts in affected health zones across Ituri and Nord-Kivu provinces.

media.caption: Public health authorities urge stronger community engagement in DRC Ebola response amid containment challenges
